# /maintain:refresh-brief → harness:refresh-brief

Invoke the Skill tool with skill `harness:refresh-brief` and args `$ARGUMENTS` verbatim, then follow that skill — the same as the user typing `/harness:refresh-brief`. Do nothing else first — no context loading, no work of your own.

If the Skill tool reports the skill unknown, the `harness` plugin is not enabled in this project. Say so and stop; do not fall back to an improvised version. To enable it here: `claude plugin install harness@ai-coding-starter --scope project` (after `claude plugin marketplace add mrozmk/AI_Coding_Starter@release`), or start the session with `claude --plugin-dir packages/claude` for development.
